name: Next Generation Movers
description: Moving quotes for AI agents from Next Generation Movers, a licensed interstate household goods carrier (USDOT 3764697, MC 1341637) in Rockville, MD. Free quotes, a $0.01 USDC x402 paid quote, and free booking requests.
author: Next Generation Movers

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Nationwide interstate and long-distance household moves between any two US states, plus local moves in the DC/Maryland/Virginia area. Licensed carrier USDOT 3764697, MC 1341637. Indicative price per tariff (not a legal estimate) between any two US ZIP codes. Long distance nationwide, per cubic foot by distance and size; local hourly in DC, MD, VA only. Costs $0.01 (x402, USDC on Base). Invalid input is rejected before payment.

to_zip.description: Destination 5-digit US ZIP, any US state. Over about 50 road miles is priced as long distance per cubic foot; shorter moves are priced hourly only within DC/MD/VA

home_size.description: Home size; used to estimate cubic feet (long distance) or crew and hours (local)

cubic_feet.description: Total shipment cubic feet, if known (350 cf minimum applies)

inventory.description: Optional item list; cubic_feet (or weight_lbs, converted at 6.5 lb/cf) per item

specialty_items.description: Bulky items with a tariff handling charge

packing.description: Full packing at $1.25 per cf (long distance)

unpacking.description: Full unpacking at $1.25 per cf (long distance)

storage_months.description: Months of storage, $50 per 100 cf per month

long_carry_feet.description: Long carry distance in feet, $100 per 75 ft

shuttle.description: Shuttle truck needed, $1.25 per cf, $700 minimum

extra_stops.description: Extra pickup or delivery stops, $150 each

guaranteed_delivery.description: Guaranteed delivery date, 42% of line haul (long distance)

est_hours.description: Local only: estimated labor hours (3-hour minimum)

tools.name: get_quote_free
tools.description: FREE. Nationwide interstate and long-distance household moves between any two US states, plus local moves in the DC/Maryland/Virginia area. Licensed carrier USDOT 3764697, MC 1341637. Same indicative price per tariff as get_quote, no payment. Any two US ZIP codes. Optional contact_name, contact_phone, contact_email let Next Generation Movers call the customer to book. Returns booking link and phone (240) 422-2243.
